kind: Multi-fold comparison with the current incumbent component and fixed class balancing
motivation: Saved-prediction diagnostic exposed a difference between pilot and submitted postprocessing. Test two fixed training recipes across more prompts; do not retroactively pass V25.

candidate.name: 8b_ce
candidate.initialization: V25 CE external-only checkpoint, including adapter and heads
candidate.training_recipe: Unchanged V25 CE host stage: two equivalent epochs; fresh optimizer and scaler; same paired sampler and seed
candidate.readout: Unchanged V25 layers 12/24/36 logistic readout, C=0.02, mean log probabilities

comparison.name: 4b_small_supcon
comparison.initialization: V18 CE+SupCon external-only checkpoint from 4500 selected external rows, including adapter and heads
comparison.training_recipe: Unchanged V18 CE+SupCon host stage: two equivalent epochs; fresh optimizer and scaler; same paired sampler and seed
comparison.readout: Unchanged V19 layers 12/24/36 logistic readout, C=0.02, mean log probabilities
comparison.reason: This recipe supplies V21's added component, our current 0.622 public incumbent; V22's larger-data component regressed publicly. This is still not validation of the full incumbent ensemble.

choice_disclosure: Candidate CE was chosen after observing V25: it ties SupCon on the balanced pilot blend and has the higher standalone readout. This is post-pilot selection, not a pre-pilot discovery claim.

scoring.sparse_reference: V32 fixed V17 sparse OOF; related holdout fits the identical specification using fixed V17 external IDs and train-only vocabulary
scoring.blend: sparse decision scores + 0.15 * mean neural log probabilities
scoring.postprocessing: Softmax then credited V16 equal-class-mass balancing for exactly 300 iterations, separately on each held-out fold; no prompt-wise one-to-one assignment
scoring.metric: Balanced accuracy (mean recall across 18 source labels)
scoring.no_selection: No weight, epoch, layer, temperature, seed or objective search. Evaluate fixed final checkpoints. Report ordinary accuracy as a diagnostic only.

bootstrap.unit: Whole prompt groups, stratified by primary fold; recompute pooled balanced accuracy for each paired resample

runtime.evidence: V25 CE host stage through completion about 3811 seconds plus 557-second readout; V18 SupCon about 1483 seconds plus 264-second V19 readout
runtime.execution: One GPU per recipe, four primary folds sequentially within each recipe; related fold only after primary qualification
runtime.launch_requires: Independent verification of external-only artifacts, exact train/holdout boundaries, notebook source, offline model dependencies and sufficient current Kaggle quota

attribution: Public pool and fixed balancing: Nishant Dahal and original contributors, CC BY-SA 4.0. Qwen backbones: Qwen. LoRA, supervised contrastive learning and QLoRA retain the cited V18/V25 method credits. This is a new evaluation protocol, not a newly invented training method.
limitations: Full credited 14B/DeBERTa ensemble is not included in local OOF; only an actual submission can prove a gain over 0.622
Pilot fold zero is reused; all development labels have been inspected before
Size, quantization, adapter coverage, objective and external-pool size differ between recipes; no pure scaling or causal method claim
Equal hidden class mass is an assumption; balancing is fixed because the submitted baseline already uses it
Related confirmation is one predeclared holdout, not full related-fold OOF
Passing supports separate full-host training and inference validation; a fold model is never submitted directly
V25 and V30 remain failed under their original gates; V33 remains unlaunched
